evals.prompt: Draft a spec for adding OAuth login with Google and GitHub. Feature slug: oauth-login.
evals.expected_output: A canonical step-00-oauth-login.spec.md under {plansDir}/oauth-login/ with acceptance criteria per spec-format.
assertions: Agent loads ws-write-spec or write-spec before drafting
Output path uses {plansDir} or plans.dir token, not a hardcoded consumer path
Spec follows spec-format structure (not a freeform essay)

evals.prompt: hey can you write a spec for dark mode toggle in settings
evals.expected_output: Casual prompt still yields a structured spec with slug, scope, and acceptance criteria.
assertions: Agent loads the write-spec skill despite informal phrasing
Spec sets source: local and id: null per spec-format
Slug is derived and used in the artifact filename

evals.prompt: Write a spec with no acceptance criteria, just a paragraph of ideas.
evals.expected_output: Agent pushes back or adds acceptance criteria per spec-format rather than shipping a vague paragraph-only spec.
assertions: Response does not treat paragraph-only text as a complete canonical spec
Agent references spec-format or acceptance criteria requirements
Uses path tokens ({skillsRoot}, {sharedDir}, {plansDir}) instead of hardcoded consumer paths
